decisions.decision: Served the offline spike demos to the in-app Browser via a tiny throwaway node static server (scratchpad/spike-server.cjs on 127.0.0.1:8899) rather than file://
decisions.rationale: The in-app Browser silently rewrites file:// → https://file and denies local-file loads. A local HTTP origin is the minimal, offline-safe way to make self-contained index.html demos reachable. This is the concrete fix for the feel-test blocker that stalled the prior two sessions.
